title: Initial smoke and normal two-peer Chore tests
scenario: No-op opcode-111 probe before artificial packet delay.
invariants: Every request executed exactly once per peer.
Command IDs and final ticks matched on both peers.
Every command ID appeared in the matching outgoing host SyncEvent.
limitations: No artificial delay was applied in these precursor runs.

title: Comprehensive two-peer 500 ms barrier test
scenario: Only incoming opcode-111 Chores on the non-host client were held for 500 ms; SyncEvents continued into native code.
invariants: Exactly one enqueue, one mode-1 serialization, one remote mode-2 sizing call, and one mode-0 execution per peer and request.
Command ID, final scheduled tick, and actual tick match across peers.
Final scheduled tick equals actual mode-0 tick.
Delayed order is incoming, held, matching barrier, repeated wait, release, reinjection, execute.
No delayed command crossed its target barrier before reinjection.
limitations: The forced-run timeout was not triggered.
Save/load, host migration, and long-duration slot recycling were not tested.
